notes.title: Patch Notes - Early Access 1.1.2
notes.content:
- Enemies are more likely to drop health when you are not at full health
- Fixed screen shake not working properly when playing with other players
- Added sounds for main menu UI

notes.title: Patch Notes - Early Access 1.1.1
notes.content:
- Mega Doom Rocket now applies bonus damage to Superior enemies in AoE and not just direct hits.
- Fixed minion damage not always applying to enemies if multiple players have same Mastermind upgrade path.
- Fixed settings having multiple of the same resolution as options.
- Fixed some UI issues with different resolutions.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Update Early Access v1.1.0
- Online Co-Op with friends, 1-4 players
- New map
- Boss fights
- New classes/upgrades
- Improved mechanics, including player movement
- Infinite rounds
- Melee combat
- Improved visuals and sounds
- Easter egg style quest with end game
